name: grokbot-whatsapp-bridge
description: Unofficial self-hosted WhatsApp (Baileys) bridge for Grok Bot's local gateway. WhatsApp twin of grokbot-telegram-bridge.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js src/core/*.js src/whatsapp/*.js test/*.js test/helpers/*.js scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && sh -n deploy/whatsapp-bridge-control.sh && sh -n deploy/health-summary.sh && echo check-ok
